FN-47NURR3-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 106
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/20/2024
Senate Bill 106 as introduced would change how salaries for the Secretary and Deputy
Secretaries for the Department of Commerce are set by removing the maximum compensation
limits currently based upon the highest authorized salary for a merit system employee of the
Department to allow: (1) the Governor, with recommendations from the State Personnel Board
to set the Secretary’s salary; and (2) the Secretary, subject to approval by the Governor, to set
the salaries for deputy secretaries.
This change could increase or decrease the obligations of the Department of Commerce by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the salary amounts authorized under
existing law and the new salary amounts established pursuant to the provisions of this bill.

FN-47NURR3-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 106
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/04/2024
Senate Bill 106 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Department of
Commerce, beginning in Fiscal Year 2024, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
difference in (1) the current salary of the Secretary of Commerce and deputy secretaries; and (2)
any new salaries set pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
